pages.text: Pale roots rise around a person-wide hollow. Amber threads hang where the trunk should be. The opening resembles the terminal aperture, though no frame has been fitted to it. These notes call it a Stillwood Hollow: the charter’s
pages.title: Bring it home
The Stillwood Hollow
pages.text: After every checkpoint and required objective, step through the hollow or use its wood. Bring any required cargo. The party returns to its terminal and the remaining reward is settled.

pages.title: What can be used again
pages.text: Samples become equipment, and a completed charter becomes a record the terminal can recognise. Check its offerings after a return. Some work needs several forms of preparation.

pages.title: What can be used again
pages.text: Tokens can be exchanged with /expeditions redeem; the available pool follows the dimension you stand in. Put useful supplies aside before spending the whole balance on another contract.
